channels.name: Travelplanet
channels.note: Production proof: canonical query and live /search-results/ajax-boxes preserve 2 adults + 2 children ages 5/7. Each accepted result must carry adult:_2_child:_2 and age:_5,7, an AAC5C7 offer-token party proof, and a total_summary bound to the same live item. The production adapter also requires the same package to have a different 2+0 total, applies strict trip/airport/quality filters, and performs a second live family recheck before alerting. JWT originalTotalPrice is explicitly not treated as the family total.

channels.name: Fly.pl
channels.note: Blocked from production after control test: Fly accepts/echoes filter[person]=2, filter[child]=2 and child ages 5/7 in the request, but the rendered/backend offer state still behaves as 2 adults / 0 children. Its 'Cena za wszystkich' is identical to the adults-only total (e.g. 1,017 PLN/os -> 2,034 PLN in both exact-family and adults-only controls), so it is not accepted as a family total.

channels.name: EXIM tours
channels.note: Production proof: live cards preserve AC1=2, KC1=2, KA1=5|7, visibly show 2 adults + 2 children, state Dostępne online, and expose a separate explicit Cena całkowita alongside Dorosły od. Validation-only broad search proved totals such as 12 616 PLN family vs 5 369 PLN adult. Strict watcher keeps 1–3 day/5–8 night/target-airport rules and fails closed on incomplete quality metadata.

channels.name: Nekera
channels.note: Exact 2+2 ages 5/7 serialization is verified. Nekera's explicit pricetype=1 ('za wszystkich') was control-tested on 40 matching listings: every displayed total was identical to the 2-adults-only total (party-sensitive count 0), so it is NOT accepted as a family total. Production remains blocked until an offer/detail endpoint prices the children.

channels.name: Grecos
channels.note: Production adapter is fail-closed: exact 2+2 ages 5/7, live API availability, party-sensitive Merlin_FullPriceParsed, departure/night/AI/airport filters, second API recheck. Hotel quality is also fail-closed; if rating/review count is absent the offer cannot alert.

channels.name: Sun & Fun
channels.note: Live production proof: exact room1=2,5,7, visible 2 adults + 2 children, exact departure date, concrete available hotel/room/meal and itemized participant prices with explicit Cena całkowita. Date-drift guard rejects shifted departures; incomplete quality metadata remains fail-closed and cannot alert. Dedicated adapter is also wired into the generic production channel runner.

channels.name: Oasis Tours
channels.note: Production proof: live BlueVendo UI/API preserves adults=2 and infants=5,7. Seven identical hotel/room/date/meal/transport packages were matched against 2+0 controls and customertotalprice increased for 2+2 (e.g. 3102 vs 1926 PLN). Adapter requires live mintrip availability, exact 1–3 day departure, 5–8 nights, AI/target airport, same-package adult control, and second API recheck; missing quality metadata fails closed.

channels.name: Rego-Bis
channels.note: Hard blocker confirmed: Rego-Bis family picker preserves 2 adults + 2 children but exposes no child-age fields at all (only a 0-17 years child category). Under Watcher-15 policy it cannot prove exact ages 5/7, so it cannot enter production even if a price is shown.
